SAKURAMOD-TEMPORARY.title: Forgotten
SAKURAMOD-TEMPORARY.description: Cards with Forgotten enter Memory at end of turn unless they are in Exhaust.
SAKURA_MOD_CARDPILE_MEMORY.title: Memory
SAKURA_MOD_CARDPILE_MEMORY.description: During this combat, cards with Forgotten enter this pile at end of turn unless they are in Exhaust.
SAKURA_MOD_CARDPILE_MEMORY.empty: There are no cards in Memory.
SAKURAMOD-REFLECTION.title: Reflection
SAKURAMOD-REFLECTION.description:
When you are attacked, the attacker takes 50% of that damage per stack, then you lose 1 stack.
At the end of the enemy turn, lose 1 stack.
SAKURAMOD-ENTER_LABYRINTH.title: Lost
SAKURAMOD-ENTER_LABYRINTH.description: Take half damage from the first attack hit each turn. Damage from [gold]Earthy[/gold] cards is unaffected and does not consume this reduction.
SAKURAMOD-REMIND.title: Remind
SAKURAMOD-REMIND.description: Choose N cards in [gold]Memory[/gold] (all of them, if fewer). Remove them and add copies into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. The copies cost 0 this turn.
SAKURAMOD-SPELL_CARD.title: Spell
SAKURAMOD-SPELL_CARD.description: A special card type that is not a Clow Card, usually consumed after being played.
SAKURAMOD-UNREAL.title: Unreal
SAKURAMOD-UNREAL.description: When this card exhausts another card, add a copy of this card into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SAKURAMOD-EARTHY_CARD.title: Earthy
SAKURAMOD-EARTHY_CARD.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing an Earthy card enters [gold]Earthy state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Earthy state, each Earthy card you play grants 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
SAKURAMOD-EARTHY_SPELL_CARD.title: Earthy
SAKURAMOD-EARTHY_SPELL_CARD.description: An Earthy spell. Counts as an Earthy card.
SAKURAMOD-EARTHY_STATE.title: Earthy state
SAKURAMOD-EARTHY_STATE.description: Whenever you play an Earthy card, gain 4 Block.
SAKURAMOD-FIREY_CARD.title: Fiery
SAKURAMOD-FIREY_CARD.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing a Fiery card enters [gold]Fiery state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Fiery state, each Fiery card you play deals 3 damage to ALL enemies.
SAKURAMOD-FIREY_SPELL_CARD.title: Fiery
SAKURAMOD-FIREY_SPELL_CARD.description: A Fiery spell. Counts as a Fiery card.
SAKURAMOD-FIREY_STATE.title: Fiery state
SAKURAMOD-FIREY_STATE.description: Whenever you play a Fiery card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
SAKURAMOD-WATERY_CARD.title: Watery
SAKURAMOD-WATERY_CARD.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing a Watery card enters [gold]Watery state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Watery state, every 2 Watery cards you play grant 1 Energy.
SAKURAMOD-WATERY_SPELL_CARD.title: Watery
SAKURAMOD-WATERY_SPELL_CARD.description: A Watery spell. Counts as a Watery card.
SAKURAMOD-WATERY_STATE.title: Watery state
SAKURAMOD-WATERY_STATE.description: Whenever you play 2 Watery cards, gain 1 Energy.
SAKURAMOD-WINDY_CARD.title: Windy
SAKURAMOD-WINDY_CARD.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing a Windy card enters [gold]Windy state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Windy state, every 2 Windy cards you play draw 1 card.
SAKURAMOD-WINDY_SPELL_CARD.title: Windy
SAKURAMOD-WINDY_SPELL_CARD.description: A Windy spell. Counts as a Windy card.
SAKURAMOD-WINDY_STATE.title: Windy state
SAKURAMOD-WINDY_STATE.description: Whenever you play 2 Windy cards, draw 1 card.
SAKURAMOD-DEBUFF.title: Debuff
SAKURAMOD-BUBBLES_BUFF.title: Dispellable Buffs
SAKURAMOD-BUBBLES_BUFF.description:
Most positive enemy powers, such as [gold]Strength[/gold], [gold]Artifact[/gold], [gold]Thorns[/gold] and [gold]Intangible[/gold].
Powers tied to an enemy's own mechanics are not removed.
SAKURAMOD-MIST_DEFENSE.title: Defensive effects
